enchantments.tooltip: Dexterity +14: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +14 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
Good Luck +4: This item gives a +4 Luck bonus to all saves and skill checks.
Underwater Action: This item grants the wearer the ability to breathe water as if it were air.
Protection +11: Passive: +11 Deflection bonus to Armor Class.
